facts.external_validation: Evaluation using a relevant dataset not used in model development

facts.principle: Plan sample size to achieve specified precision of performance estimates
facts.rules_of_thumb_limit: Generic counts of events and non-events are not tailored to the model or setting

studies.permitted_claim: Further validation should plan sample size for precise performance estimation
studies.limits: No sample-size formula, minimum event rule, retrospective power calculation or prospective recruitment target is applied to the current availability-based internal analysis. Limited minority-class observations are not established as the sole cause of uncertainty or classification errors.

own_study_claims.claim: Single-scan Fusion-minus-M1 AUC interval is -0.0151422971184197 to 0.25221780024757906, conditional on saved OOF predictions
The selected 135 examinations retain the same 135 source patients as the 182-examination primary imaging cohort
Treatment-related-change examinations decline from 41 to 22; selection changes examination composition, labels per selected patient, training data and grouped partitions
Selection uses the smallest available numeric session, not a verified first clinical visit
At the unchanged 0.5 threshold, single-scan Fusion recognizes 2/22 treatment-related-change and 109/113 tumor examinations

interpretations: The interval includes both a small negative increment and a larger positive increment, leaving the presence and magnitude of incremental discrimination uncertain
Changes between the primary and single-scan analyses cannot be attributed solely to removing repeat examinations
One examination per patient equalizes examination contributions in that selected analysis but does not supply an independent cohort or verify source diagnoses
The low treatment-change recognition applies to the fixed threshold and does not establish that no other threshold could recognize more treatment-change examinations
Further independent evaluation is a recommendation, not a claim that such evaluation has occurred
